name: DeepFlow-HPC
description: GPU-accelerated fluid simulation with documented code, results, and presentation materials.
detail: Built using Python, Ray, Numba JIT, and CUDA for parallel processing. Won the Deep-flow HPC competition at IIT Guwahati in February 2025.
